crossRefs.note: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after…
There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his…
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun, that there is one event to all: yes also, the heart of the sons of…
There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, the sort of error which proceeds from the ruler.
The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them…
All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a…
For all this I laid to my heart, even to explore all this: that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, are in…
“It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.
“How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes…
He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.
Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,
For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.
Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

translations.web: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.
translations.bsb: There is a futility that is done on the earth: There are righteous men who get what the actions of the wicked deserve, and there are wicked men who get what the actions of the righteous deserve. I say that this too is futile.
translations.kjv: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
translations.asv: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth, that there are righteous men unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there are wicked men to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
